title: Add Two Numbers
question: Read two integers from the user and print their sum.
code:
first = int(input("First number: "))
second = int(input("Second number: "))
print("Sum:", first + second)
expected_output:
For inputs 4 and 6:
First number: 4
Second number: 6
Sum: 10
explanation: input() reads text, int() converts the text to an integer, and + adds the two values.
